text: 還用舊格式（at、days、text）的排程檔；各插件的排程檔都改成 when 和 do 之後（階段 4）
why: Schedule files in the older at/days/text form are still read; a new install writes when/do and never reaches this.

text: hook 還由 dchook 自己寫的裝法（dcbot/install.sh、deploy.sh 和遠端串流的 --update）；hook 只由 plugins.py apply 寫、deploy.sh 和 tmux_bridge.py 不再叫 dchook --update 之後
why: dchook --install/--update/--uninstall: deploy.sh and the remote streams still call --update to keep the global hooks current; plugins.py apply writes the same hooks from core.plugin.json.

text: crontab 還是舊格式的機器（# planner、# usage，或沒有標記的行）；每台的 crontab 都沒有舊格式的行（plugins.py plan 沒有 old、unclaimed）之後
why: Claiming crontab lines with the older markers (# planner, # usage, none): a new install has only altention: markers, so this never matches there.
